notes: QA audit batch 2 fixes (v1.11.24, report §14): BUG-010 update-zip validation now caps expanded size BEFORE extraction (entries ≤5000, each file ≤20 MB, total ≤100 MB; a 306 KB zip expanding to 300 MB is refused before anything is unpacked); BUG-011 box_api_update has one rule for immutable fields — topic/is_test on a programme box now 400 with the field name, alone or combined with other fields (was silently dropped in combined updates); BUG-012 redirects are re-checked for https on every fetch (ICS, Google API, Gemini, manifest and auto-update download share one guarded opener; an http downgrade is refused); BUG-013 nested state values are validated in merge_state (non-numeric/negative tests_total and actualMinutes entries dropped, wrong-typed done/tests/edits/custom_boxes/chapterSR/timerSessions/testLog entries dropped, title ≤500 / note ≤5000 / subject ≤100 chars, and the box API 400s over-long titles/notes/subjects at the boundary); BUG-014 the efficiency quality-indicator gate is now enforced in anRenderQuality (≥3 boxes with recorded useful AND ≥60 real minutes — it existed only in a comment before, so one useful box could show 100%); BUG-015 the daily analysis now has the missing 'study' bucket (plain study boxes were invisible: planned 615 vs cls 270 + gen 90 + test 90 = 450); BUG-016 the add-box form rejects zero-length boxes (same edZeroLength check as the edit form) and validates the derived subject — an unknown subject like «مرور شیمی» no longer creates a phantom subject, it falls back to «عمومی»; BUG-017 a manual test count no longer silently discards linked boxes' tests — the topic row now shows «تست باکس‌ها در این مجموع نیست (N تست)» when a manual count wins; BUG-018 renderAll() now computes allBoxes() once per render and memoizes topicAgg() per topic (was ~1,889× / ~1,464× per render, ~2,374 ms); BUG-019 slow sync/push no longer holds STATE_LOCK over network I/O — ICS fetch, Google push and push-one run in three phases (short locked snapshot, network with no state lock, short locked diff-commit), so ticks and timer saves are never frozen by a slow Google call. Known totals unchanged: حسابان 3489, شیمی 3000; گسسته and فیزیک have none (2110 not reintroduced). The 1.11.18 examDateText live-computation fix is untouched.
